author: Huawei
description:
What happens when a 5,000-year-old village meets gigabit connectivity?

In Khinalig, once isolated by mountains, high-speed fiber is opening new doors to education, business, and cultural exchange. From livestreaming traditional crafts to enabling online learning and remote work, connectivity is helping communities thrive without leaving home.

Through the Online Azerbaijan strategy, #Huawei and Aztelekom are bringing gigabit networks to even the most remote regions, narrowing the digital divide and unlocking new opportunities.

Because when connection reaches everyone, no place is too far, and no dream is out of reach.

Learn more: https://bit.ly/4eBovR1 #GreenIntelligentOptiX #UltraGigabit #TECHcares
title: How Gigabit Fiber Is Transforming Remote Azerbaijan Communities

author: Huawei
description: #Huawei has launched a plastic reduction and elimination initiative guided by four principles: reduce, eliminate, reuse, and recycle. Huawei is cutting plastic use across packaging, materials, and daily operations, including the use of recycled and eco friendly materials and reusable tableware in campus canteens. Watch how #Huawei takes the initiative global to build a greener supply chain: https://bit.ly/4dXsF5x #TECHcares
title: Huawei Advances Plastic Reduction & Elimination Initiative
